**Model / Feature Description**
A clear and concise description of the architecture or feature being proposed (e.g. ESM-2, Ankh, Graph Attention Network).

**Biological / Machine Learning Motivation**
Why would this architecture or modality benefit Alzheimer's target classification?

**References / Precedents**

**Zero-Leakage Compliance**
